text:
Gold Price in 1972
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1972, the LBMA gold price rose 37.6% between 1972-01-31 ($47.15) and 1972-12-29 ($64.90). The highest sampled price was $68.30 in July and the lowest was $47.15 in January. The mean of these observations was $59.14. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
